candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Thai script characters and subword tokens.
This vector represents conjunctions and disjunctions across multiple languages, including words and symbols meaning "and" or "or".
This feature vector activates on Thai language subword prefixes and structural morphemes, particularly variations of the preposition/prefix "กับ" (gab) and related consonantal clusters.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ม' (Mo Ma) combined with various Thai vowels, tone marks, and preceding words.
This feature vector is related to subword fragments, technical tokens, and multi-lingual characters often associated with data corruption or encoding artifacts.
This feature vector activates strongly on language names, country demonyms, and linguistic script fragments across multiple writing systems.
This vector activates on a diverse mix of multilingual subword fragments, phonetic characters, and short lexical roots spanning English, Thai, and Latin-script languages.
This vector activates on various sub-word tokens, punctuation marks, and multi-lingual characters that appear frequently in ungrammatical or noisy web-scraped text.
This feature vector activates on isolated consonant letters and short phonetic subword fragments.
This vector represents multilingual text fragments, punctuation marks, and sub-word tokens with a high concentration of Thai script characters.
